subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas com funções exponenciais nos quais seja necessário compreender e interpretar a variação das grandezas envolvidas, em contextos como o da Matemática Financeira, entre outros.

components.description_pt: Identificar quantidades que variam exponencialmente em contexto real dado
components.description_en: Identify the quantities that vary exponentially in a given real-world context
components.cc_component_description: Identify the quantities in a problem and understand their relationships before computing

components.description_pt: Interpretar parâmetros de função exponencial em termos de contexto
components.description_en: Interpret the parameters in a exponential function in terms of a context
components.cc_component_description: Interpret the parameters in a exponential function in terms of a context

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas de crescimento ou decaimento exponencial em contextos financeiros ou científicos
components.description_en: Solve problems involving exponential growth or decay in financial or scientific contexts
components.cc_component_description: Solve problems leading to an exponential equation in one variable in a contextual situation

components.description_pt: Criar equações exponenciais em duas variáveis para representar relações entre quantidades
components.description_en: Create exponential equations in two variables to represent relationships between quantities
components.cc_component_description: Create exponential equations in two variables to represent relationships between quantities

components.description_pt: Analisar como mudanças em parâmetros afetam o comportamento de função exponencial
components.description_en: Analyze how changes in parameters affect the behavior of an exponential function
components.cc_component_description: Interpret the parameters in a exponential function in terms of a context

cc_matches.description: Interpret the parameters in a linear or exponential function in terms of a context.
Create equations in two or more variables to represent relationships between quantities; graph equations on coordinate axes with labels and scales.
Create equations and inequalities in one variable and use them to solve problems. Include equations arising from linear and quadratic functions, and simple rational and exponential functions.
